subject: Re: Technical Screen Ops — Aaron Kim (ML)
thread_summary: Coordination between recruiter, hiring team, and candidate to finalize ML technical screen time, interviewer roles, platform links, and scoring rubric. Adds backup interviewer and confirms environment details for candidate.
messages:
From: Sophie Park <sophie@talentbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduling: ML technical screen for Aaron Kim — Redwood

Hi Marcus / Maya,

Hope you’re both well. I’m coordinating the ML technical screen for Aaron Kim (resume attached in HubSpot). He’s available next week and has indicated preference for mornings PST. Proposed slots: 2027-04-13 09:30–10:30 PT, 2027-04-14 10:00–11:00 PT, or 2027-04-15 08:30–09:30 PT.

The interview format per job spec is: 45 min coding/ML problem (shared Colab or CoderPad), 15 min Q&A + debrief with hiring manager. Would you confirm:
- Which interviewer will own the coding portion vs model architecture Q&A?
- Any special dataset or notebook we should stage?

I’ve placed a tentative CoderPad link below; will finalize once you confirm.

CoderPad (provisional): https://coderpad.io/p/AB12CDE
HubSpot candidate: HS-48291

Attachments: Aaron_Kim_resume.pdf (in HubSpot)

Thanks — I can loop in the candidate once you pick a slot.

— Sophie Park
Senior Technical Recruiter, TalentBridge
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@talentbridge.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: ML technical screen for Aaron Kim — Redwood

Thanks Sophie — quick notes from my side:

I can own the coding/engineering problem and live debugging (CoderPad). Maya will take model architecture / system design + the debrief. Please add Dev as backup interviewer; he can jump in for the last 15 min or cover if I’m on another call.

Preferred slot: 2027-04-14 10:00–11:00 PT (cleanest on my calendar). If candidate wants an earlier morning, 04-15 at 08:30 works but it’s tight for Maya.

Platform links & test infra:
- Primary: CoderPad session (use the provisional link Sophie shared).
- Backup/Notebook: Google Colab template (I uploaded starter notebook and test vectors): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1gX_testcases
- Scoring rubric (internal): technical_rubric.xlsx (attached).

Interviewer responsibilities:
- Marcus: lead coding prompt, check for correctness, runtime tradeoffs, and prompt engineering awareness.
- Maya: model architecture, deployment considerations, and candidate cultural fit for ML infra.
- Dev: backup; if present, run through inference latency question and take notes.

Please make the CoderPad ephemeral link and send candidate instructions: preferred language (Python), do not share external internet access, but Colab will be provided if they prefer. Also note we expect them to run the notebook quickly — it’s a focused problem, not a take-home.

I’ll attach a short interviewer instructions PDF with suggested questions and time checkpoints.

— Marcus Lin
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sophie Park <sophie@talentbridge.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: ML technical screen for Aaron Kim — Redwood

Agree with Marcus — 04-14 10:00–11:00 PT works for me. A couple of addenda:

1) Please ensure the rubric includes a check for reproducibility steps and whether the candidate reasons about KV cache / latency trade-offs for transformer inference (small checklist in the rubric).
2) I’ll need the candidate’s linked GitHub or a pointer to any public repos they rely on (quick sanity check).
3) Please mark the calendar invite with 'Redwood — Technical Screen (Aaron Kim) — CoderPad' and include the Colab link in the body in case CoderPad has issues.

I uploaded a short scoring template (interviewer_instructions.pdf) with time-boxed prompts and red flags. Marcus — can you confirm you’ll paste the seed tests into CoderPad before we start?

— Maya
Engineering Manager, ML Serving
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Park <sophie@talentbridge.com>
To: Aaron Kim <aaron.kim@gmail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: ML technical screen for Aaron Kim — Redwood

Hi Aaron — quick note to confirm the panel and logistics. Marcus (Senior Staff Engineer) and Maya (Engineering Manager) from Redwood will conduct the 60-minute screen. We’ve penciled you in for: 2027-04-14 at 10:00 AM PT.

What to expect:
- 45 min live coding/ML problem (CoderPad).
- 15 min debrief + role fit.

Please confirm this slot and tell us if you prefer CoderPad (default) or Google Colab (we’ll send the Colab link). Also share your preferred language (Python is fine) and your GitHub link if available.

Candidate reply requested by EOD 2027-04-12 so interviewers can prepare test scaffolding.

Thanks — Sophie
From: Aaron Kim <aaron.kim@gmail.com>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@talentbridge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: ML technical screen for Aaron Kim — Redwood

Thanks, Sophie — 04-14 10:00 AM PT works for me. I prefer Python and CoderPad is fine. My public GitHub: https://github.com/aaron-kim-ml (contains short inference projects).

Quick Q: will internet access be allowed inside the Pad / Colab? I typically rely on small helper snippets but can bring everything into the session.

— Aaron
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Kim <aaron.kim@gmail.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Sophie Park <sophie@talentbridge.com>, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-12T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: ML technical screen for Aaron Kim — Redwood

Aaron — quick reply on internet access: CoderPad will NOT allow external internet. If you prefer to run code that needs pip installs or external repos, use the Colab option we’ll send (internet available but time is still limited). Either is fine — Python preferred.

We’ll send the final invite with both links and attach the rubric and interviewer instructions. Looking forward to it.

— Marcus
Senior Staff Engineer, Redwood Inference
